sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their commanding position at the top of the table. The Ramblers secured a convincing 2-0 victory over Eccleshall earlier today with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley, maintaining their unbeaten run and strengthening their grip on first place with 22 points from 10 games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town drew 3-3 away at Cheadle Heath Nomads after going down to 10 men, earning a late point through Mazurkiewicz's 83rd-minute leveller. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth suffered their first defeat in five games, losing 1-0 at home to Brereton Social via an own goal. Wolverhampton Casuals made it four wins in six with a commanding 3-1 away victory at Shawbury United. Bilston Town remain in contention with a dominant 3-0 home win over Market Drayton Town, who played most of the match with ten men. Lower-down, Allscott Heath secured an impressive 4-1 home win over struggling Alsager Town, Barnton continued their unbeaten run with a 2-0 away victory at Telford Town, New Mills lost 2-1 at home to Dawley Town, Wednesfield Community recorded their first clean sheet with a 1-0 away win at Crewe, and Foley Meir's fixture against Widnes Town appears listed twice in the fixture list.
